title: security: RBAC v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation:
We observed two related gaps in RBAC v2 behavior exposed by recent audits: (1) KMS keys could be created or referenced in regions not covered by a project's residency policy during role-bound operations, and (2) audit logs for RBAC policy decisions were missing sufficient context (requested resource region, effective KMS key region, and enforced residency policy) to accurately triage cross-region access. This PR hardens enforcement and improves auditability so that organizations can rely on RBAC v2 + KMS region pinning for compliance.

What this PR does (single-string summary):
- Enforce KMS region pinning at the RBAC enforcement layer: when a policy requires residency, the enforcer rejects requests that reference KMS keys outside allowed regions.
- Add an explicit residency_match flag and resolved_kms_region field to RBAC audit events so downstream SIEMs can validate enforcement decisions.
- Add a compatibility policy check that falls back to an allow-with-audit mode in environments configured for staged rollout.
- Update the RBAC policy schema docs and add migration validation tooling for existing policies.

Detailed changes included in this PR: checklist:
- [x] rbac/enforcer: implement region pinning check and failure path (deny with detailed audit event)
- [x] rbac/audit: include resolved_kms_region, residency_required, and residency_match in log payloads
- [x] api: expose residency_hint on policy GET/PUT to surface to Console
- [x] schema: add kms_region_pin object to rbac v2 schema and validate on write
- [x] installer: add upgrade validation that detects incompatible existing KMS bindings and prints migration suggestions
- [x] tests: unit + integration tests covering deny/allow-with-audit/staged-rollout modes
- [x] docs: update security/compliance guide and one-line release notes

Backward compatibility & rollout:
- Default behavior for clusters without residency policies is unchanged. For customers enabling residency enforcement, we provide a staged rollout via a cluster-level feature flag (rbac.v2.kms_region_pinning.mode = "enforce|audit|disabled"). The default for new installs is "audit" to reduce breaking customer traffic until they opt-in to "enforce". Migration tooling warns when policies reference KMS ARNs in disallowed regions.

Operational notes:
- Audit events include both the requested KMS ARN and the resolved_kms_region; SIEM parsers should use resolved_kms_region for aggregation.
- We added a Prometheus metric rbac_kms_region_pin_denied_total with labels (policy, org, region) to enable alerting on unexpected denials.

References: ENG-4982, SEC-1123, SUP-8876. See linked Linear tickets for verification checklist and post-deploy runbook.

release_notes:
- Enforcement: RBAC v2 can now enforce KMS region pinning against residency policies (feature flag: rbac.v2.kms_region_pinning.mode)
- Audit: RBAC audit events include resolved_kms_region and residency_match for improved compliance telemetry
- Installer: validation step added to detect KMS ARNs in disallowed regions during upgrades
